scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @hestiva/web & npm run dev --workspace @hestiva/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hestiva/api && npm run build --workspace @hestiva/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @hestiva/api && npm run test --workspace @hestiva/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hestiva/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @hestiva/web
scripts.deploy:api: npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run start --workspace @hestiva/api
